long_biography.plain_text:
Prince Abdulaziz bin Fahd helped organise an exhibition devoted to the life and reign of his father, King Fahd. He described the project as a way for younger Saudis to understand the late king's work and the period he led. The role turned family memory into a public historical programme for a new generation.

Education formed another area of public contribution. Abdulaziz supported an endowment at the Islamic University of Madinah intended to provide housing for international students. The project addressed a specific institutional need for students who had travelled to the city from outside Saudi Arabia.
